title: Four coefficientwise section operators for a two-parameter translation commutator
statement: Let S be an arbitrary scheme and G/S a group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let v,w be points over S[epsilon] reducing to the identity [def-sc-dual-numbers]. For every open U of G put R=Gamma(U,O_G), and let D_v,D_w be the epsilon coefficients of right translation by v,w on R. Write a double dual number as (a00+epsilon a10)+delta(a01+epsilon a11). Define E_D to send its four coefficients to (a00,a10+D(a00),a01,a11+D(a01)), and F_D to send them to (a00,a10,a01+D(a00),a11+D(a10)). For z=v_epsilon w_delta v_epsilon^{-1} w_delta^{-1}, right translation of the universal G-point by z has, on every constant section a of R, comorphism E_{D_v}(F_{D_w}(E_{-D_v}(F_{-D_w}(a)))). This is equality in R[epsilon][delta], before mixed-coefficient extraction. The translation is the explicit product of the universal point and z pulled back along G[epsilon][delta] to S[epsilon][delta]. No affine, field, characteristic, or smoothness hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Base change right translation by v to the double dual-number thickening. Its reduction is the identity and its epsilon coefficient on constants is D_v by construction. Being over the parameter scheme it fixes epsilon and delta, hence on four components it is the explicit epsilonSectionAction. Similarly translation by w is deltaSectionAction. The inverse operators use -D_v and -D_w, since epsilon squared and delta squared are zero.

Associativity of the group law identifies right translation by v_epsilon w_delta v_epsilon^{-1} w_delta^{-1} with successive right translations by the four factors. Contravariance orders their section operators with epsilonSectionAction D_v outermost. All underlying maps are identity since v and w reduce to the identity. Apply the composite to the constant section a on any open U. This proves the full double-dual-number section equality; no mixed coefficient is extracted.

theorem twoParameterRightTranslation_commutator_app
    (v w : infPoints G) (U : G.left.Opens)
    (e : U ≤ (twoParameterRightTranslation G
      ((Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1) * (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1) *
        (Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1)⁻¹ *
          (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1)⁻¹)) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (a : Γ(G.left, U)) :
    (twoParameterRightTranslation G
      ((Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1) * (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1) *
        (Scheme.dualNumbersProjεOver S ≫ v.1)⁻¹ *
          (Scheme.dualNumbersProjδOver S ≫ w.1)⁻¹)).appLE U U e a =
      epsilonSectionAction (invariantCoefficient G v U)
        (deltaSectionAction (invariantCoefficient G w U)
          (epsilonSectionAction (-invariantCoefficient G v U)
            (deltaSectionAction (-invariantCoefficient G w U) (inl (inl a)))))
